was in the spotlight on Monday as Needham upped its price target on the cybersecurity company to $230 from $200 ahead of its upcoming flagship conference.

"We will be listening for early product traction and feedback for Okta's AI products, underscoring upside catalysts to investors' multi-year bull thesis," analyst Mike Cikos wrote in a note to clients. "We anticipate the analyst session will be aligned with investor expectations: an opportunity for Q&A with no updates to the financial model or targets, and as a result, we take a longer-term view of Okta as we make our annual trip to Oktane by considering: Is Okta positioned to capture the revenue opportunity from increasing identity density, and what are implications to the model? Can Okta elevate its station within customers' cybersecurity stack to an identity infrastructure control plane from its traditional IAM roots?
Cikos reiterated his Buy rating on Okta.

title: Okta in focus as Needham ups price target ahead of conference
